text:
Priya (People Ops): Heads-up — we have a candidate for Staff ML Infra on Tues 3/30 10:00–11:00 PT. Need coverage for panel: system design (Elena), infra deep-dive (Samir), culture + product fit (Maya). Can folks confirm?

Elena: I can do system design but I have a 10:30 hard stop. Is it possible to split into two 30m blocks? :hourglass_flowing_sand: 

Samir: I can take infra deep-dive slot fully. If Elena needs 10:00–10:30, I can move to 10:30–11:00.

Maya: I’m happy to cover product/culture. 10:00–10:30 works for me. Quick q — are we using the standard hiring rubric or the inference-specialist weights?

Priya (People Ops): Using the Staff ML Infra rubric but we want to emphasize "scales and tradeoffs" and "latency/cost reasoning" — weight = 30% for design, 40% infra, 30% culture/product. I’ll paste anchors below.

Priya (People Ops): Rubric anchors (copy from doc):
```
Design (30%): evaluates capacity to design for throughput, sharding, KV cache, and fallback policies.
Infra (40%): infra design, deployment tradeoffs, autoscaling, monitoring/observability.
Product (30%): tradeoff communication, team fit, and prioritization.

Anchors: 1 = misses core tradeoffs, 3 = solid with some gaps, 5 = clear ownership + novel ops ideas.
```

Aisha: Thanks — one clarification: for the "KV cache" item, are we expecting candidates to know specific cache eviction strategies or higher-level patterns?

Samir: High-level patterns + a couple practical evictions (LRU vs TTL) is enough. If they mention prefix caching and cache warming that's a plus but not required.

Devon: I can be backup if someone drops. Also can help score the latency reasoning section — I’ve got standard prompts to elicit numbers.

Elena: Ok that works. I’ll do 10:00–10:30 design, Maya will do 10:30–11:00 product? (per Samir's move)

Maya: Yep, can do 10:30–11:00.

Priya (People Ops): Great. @recruiter-bot please confirm candidate timezone (they said CET) and send updated calendar block.

recruiter-bot: Candidate confirmed — CET. Calendar invite sent as 10:00–11:00 PT / 19:00–20:00 CET. Resume link: https://drive.redwood/resumes/2026/staff-ml-infra-lee.pdf

Priya (People Ops): Two small asks before panel: 1) please review the short prompt set (tech prompts + one product scenario) I uploaded to the hiring drive; 2) if you plan to use a code whiteboard, drop a note here so we set up a private doc.

Samir: I’ll prepare infra prompts and add them to the drive.

Elena: No code whiteboard from me.

Maya: I’ll bring product scenario, will create private doc and drop link ~30m before panel.

Devon: calendar-bot shows everyone accepted except Elena — she still tentative.

Elena: Sorry I had to keep tentative while I confirm the hard stop workaround. Accepted now. :white_check_mark:

Priya (People Ops): Awesome — final note on scoring: try to capture one concrete example for each anchor (strength, weakness, follow-up question). We'll do a 10m debrief right after the interview in the same room.

Maya: Sounds good. See you all Tues. :wave:

Priya (People Ops): Thanks team — I’ll send the debrief reminder 10m before interview.
